title: DUI? How about you die
description: A tech mod for minecraft that adds Booze, among other things of higher importance
body:
DUI? How About You Die? — The ultimate beverage mod for thrill-seeking crafters.

Dive into a world of booze-fueled fun and reckless experimentation with:

-Beer, Wine, Vodka, and Gin — because Minecraft thirst deserves variety.
-Grapes and Juniper Berries — your new go-to ingredients for crafting the finest drinks.
-Uranium Fuel Rods — edible? Sure. Safe? Absolutely not. Handle with care or just dive headfirst into radioactive mayhem.

Not for the faint-hearted, this mod mixes classic drinks with dangerously unexpected elements. Inspired by a killer song and brewed with a dash of dark humor. Play responsibly, or don’t.
